reasons.text: The duplicate check found another claim (ab27d02a-fdcb-56c6-8fc5-c14379c31e0f) that shares a payout destination with this claim. Program policy sends any claim sharing a payout account to a person for review, together with the matched claim.

Otherwise the claim would qualify: the label photo is legible and shows model P1411, which is a recalled model; the purchase was at a listed retailer (www.amazon.com) and the stated date falls before the sale window, but the receipt is not required for this check.
The purchase date of 2006-03-22 is before the sale window (2006-10-01 to 2021-12-31), which under the policy would normally be a denial. The reviewer should weigh this alongside the flag.
